sourceData.mnemonic: Because the hiragana ends with an <ja>う</ja> sound, you know this word is a verb. The kanji itself means <kanji>paste</kanji> so the verb vocab is <vocabulary>to paste</vocabulary> (or <vocabulary>to stick</vocabulary>).
sourceData.readingMnemonic: The reading is the same as the one you learned with the kanji.
